scope: Every registered HTTP/WebSocket route in app.main runtime; current API prefix default /api; no endpoint invocation or database session
limitations: Static call trace limited to depth 3 (dependency helper depth 2); dynamic dispatch and nested closures are not an authorization proof.
Observed keys can occur in masking or audit paths and are not automatically mandatory grants.
CORS and migration body-size/no-store middleware are not authorization gates.
Runtime dependency list includes router and app.include_router injected dependencies.
